news.title: Jesus snatches late win for Forest as Villa's poor start continues
news.summary: Igor Jesus scores an 88th minute winner as Nottingham Forest beat Aston Villa at Villa Park for the first time in 32 years and gives Oliver Glasner his first victory as Forest head coach since taking charge in the summer.
news.title_tr: Villa'nın kötü başlangıcı devam ederken Jesus, Forest adına son galibiyetini aldı
